hero.name: Siddharajsinh Chauhan

hero.resumeSummary: Full-stack software engineer with {{years}}+ years building ecommerce web applications for USA, UK and Portugal clients, mainly meal delivery and online shopping. Primary developer on 5+ production sites, typically building about 90% of each: storefront, cart, checkout, payments, subscriptions and order processing. React.js, TypeScript and Next.js on the frontend; Node.js/Express.js, Python/FastAPI and ASP.NET Core on the backend. Use AI coding tools daily for development and testing, and review their output against real production requirements.

paragraphs: I'm a Full-Stack Software Engineer with {{years}}+ years of experience building and scaling production web applications. My passion lies in crafting intuitive, performant, and beautiful solutions — from pixel-perfect React UIs to resilient Node.js backends.

React and TypeScript are my primary tools of choice. I've spent the last few years building complex SPAs, optimizing performance, integrating payment gateways like Stripe, and shipping features that real users rely on every day.
Outside of coding, I enjoy hiking, playing cricket, reading tech blogs, and contributing to open-source. I thrive in collaborative Agile environments and I'm always excited to take on new challenges.

description: Lead developer on full-stack ecommerce web apps in React.js, TypeScript, Next.js and Node.js, from architecture through release.
Build backend services and REST APIs, including payment gateway and authentication integrations.
Work directly with clients and stakeholders to define requirements, scope the work and keep releases on schedule.

Primary developer on 5+ production ecommerce sites for USA, UK and Portugal clients, building about 90% of each (storefront, cart, checkout, order processing) in React.js, TypeScript, Next.js and Node.js with Python/FastAPI or ASP.NET Core backends.
Delivered Stripe and Authorize.net card payments and ID.me identity verification in checkout and account flows.
Cut wrong delivery addresses at checkout by rebuilding address forms on the Google Maps Places API with reworked autofill logic.
Accelerated page loads by 10X and shrank bundle size by 45% through code splitting and lazy loading, and re-architected complex forms into reusable components with centralized Redux state.

Built responsive, cross-browser client websites with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and jQuery, and supported senior developers on ASP.NET Web Forms and ASP.NET MVC backends in C# and SQL Server, including QA testing and bug fixing.

testimonials.name: Ravi Patel
testimonials.quote: Sid turned around a complex Stripe + Authorize.net integration in record time. His TypeScript is clean, his PRs are well-structured, and he always asks the right clarifying questions before diving in.

testimonials.name: Anita Sharma
testimonials.quote: Working with Sid on the React UI was a pleasure. He translates Figma comps pixel-perfectly and proactively suggests micro-animations that genuinely improve the UX rather than just adding noise.

testimonials.name: Mihir Desai
testimonials.quote: Sid's Node/Express APIs are consistently well-thought-out — proper error handling, sensible status codes, and he writes integration tests without being asked. A developer you can actually depend on.

testimonials.name: Priya Mehta
testimonials.quote: He shipped a Google Maps autocomplete feature end-to-end in 3 days with zero reported bugs. Strong self-starter who doesn't need his hand held through ambiguous requirements.

testimonials.name: Jatin Vora
testimonials.quote: We built a multi-tenant SaaS dashboard together. Sid's performance optimisations — bundle splitting, lazy routes, memo boundaries — cut initial load from 4.2 s to under 1.3 s. Impressive stuff.

testimonials.name: Sneha Kapoor
testimonials.quote: His code quality means our QA cycles are shorter. Fewer regressions, self-documenting components, and he actually writes unit tests alongside features. A rare find in the frontend world.

projects.title: MightyMeals
projects.description: High-traffic ecommerce platform for an $18M USD annual revenue meal delivery business, processing thousands of transactions a week. Headless React.js frontend on a WooCommerce backend via REST APIs, with custom ordering workflows and secure payment processing.
resumeBullets: High-traffic ecommerce platform for an $18M USD annual revenue meal delivery business, processing thousands of transactions a week. Headless React.js frontend on a WooCommerce backend via REST APIs, with custom ordering workflows and secure payment processing.
Frontend architecture: built and maintain the custom React.js ecommerce app with reusable components and dynamic product browsing.
Checkout and payments: integrated Authorize.net and Stripe; built custom checkout for complex payment and order-processing rules.

Autoship subscriptions: led development of the custom recurring-delivery system that lets customers schedule, manage and automate repeat orders, covering recurring order generation, payment, delivery scheduling and account management.
Order management: built custom order creation workflows linking the frontend to backend APIs for customer, product and payment data.
Performance and UX: frontend and performance work for a high-volume store, improving product discovery, cart and checkout usability.
